# CoopGig Admin

> Admin dashboard for Cooperative Gig Services — a cooperative platform connecting skilled workers with gig opportunities.

The admin dashboard lets cooperative and federation administrators manage workers, track bookings, and view demand forecasting analytics.

## Pages

- [Dashboard](/): Platform overview with key metrics
- [Bookings](/bookings): Manage and filter bookings
- [Workers](/workers): Manage registered workers
- [Forecast](/forecast): Demand forecasting analytics
